about.en: GOOGLon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Alphabet Inc. Class A shares (GOOGL), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by GOOGL shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xbA47214eDd2bb43099611b208f75E4b42FDcfEDc, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
